title: Give every task-sync exchange driver a production route to finish a committed step whose origin witness was left pending
outcome: Give every task-sync exchange driver a production route to finish a committed step whose origin witness was left pending
acceptance: after a committed exchange step returns an error with its private origin witness still pending (post-commit check or witness write failing), retrying the same public operation (delta publish and publish retry, incoming delta apply, planning-successor apply) finishes that witness without a second dispatch and then proceeds, with driver-level tests for each
the 'previous origin exchange step committed; retry that exact step' refusal names the pending request or operation
